title: Kentucky Fried Chicken
description: Kentucky Fried Chicken is a classic Continental-style crispy fried chicken featuring tender, buttermilk-marinated chicken coated in a flavorful seasoned crust and deep-fried until perfectly golden. Served with creamy mashed potatoes, charred vegetables, and a spiced aioli, it delivers a refined restaurant-quality dining experience.

ingredients.title: For the Chicken Marinade
items: Whole chicken (1.2–1.5 kg), cut into 8–10 pieces – 1
Buttermilk (or whole milk + 1 tbsp lemon juice) – 500 ml

ingredients.title: For Frying
items: Neutral frying oil (peanut, sunflower, or refined canola) – as required

ingredients.title: For Continental Plating & Accompaniments
items: Truffle mashed potatoes or garlic mashed potatoes
Charred seasonal vegetables (asparagus, baby carrots, zucchini)
Microgreens or fresh parsley for garnish

instruction.title: Step 1 – Marinate the Chicken
steps: In a large bowl, combine buttermilk, garlic powder, onion powder, smoked paprika, cayenne pepper, salt, black pepper, and Worcestershire sauce.
Add the chicken pieces and coat thoroughly.
Cover and refrigerate for at least 6 hours, preferably overnight.

instruction.title: Step 2 – Prepare the Coating
steps: Mix the flour, cornstarch, baking powder, salt, peppers, paprika, mustard seed, celery salt, oregano, thyme, ginger, and nutmeg in a large bowl.
Remove the chicken from the marinade and shake off excess liquid.
Coat each piece generously in the seasoned flour mixture, pressing firmly to create a thick, craggy crust.
Place the coated chicken on a wire rack and let it rest for 15 minutes.

instruction.title: Step 3 – Fry the Chicken
steps: Add the optional clarified butter for additional flavor.
Fry the chicken in batches without overcrowding the pan.
Cook until the coating is golden brown and the internal temperature reaches 74°C (165°F).
Drain on a wire rack to maintain maximum crispness.

instruction.title: Step 4 – Plate Like Fine Dining
steps: Arrange 2–3 pieces of crispy fried chicken on a warm serving plate.
Add a quenelle of truffle or garlic mashed potatoes.
Neatly arrange the charred seasonal vegetables alongside.
Serve with a small ramekin of spiced aioli or paprika mayonnaise.

instruction.title: Step 5 – Final Touch
steps: Garnish with fresh microgreens or chopped parsley.
Optionally drizzle parsley oil around the plate for an elegant finish.
Serve immediately while the chicken is hot and crispy.

servingSuggestions.title: Serving Suggestions
items: Serve hot with garlic or truffle mashed potatoes.
Pair with charred seasonal vegetables for a balanced meal.
Enjoy with spiced aioli, paprika mayonnaise, or classic gravy.
Pair with Chardonnay, sparkling wine, or iced lemonade.

chefTips: Double dredge the chicken by dipping it back into the buttermilk and flour for an extra crispy crust.
Maintain the oil temperature between 165–170°C to ensure even cooking and a crisp coating.
Drain fried chicken on a wire rack instead of paper towels to preserve its crunch.
Allow the chicken to marinate overnight for maximum tenderness and flavor.
Serve immediately after frying for the best texture and restaurant-quality presentation.
